## Key work (verified numbers)
- TRACER — real-time UPI mule-ring fraud detection. NetworkX graph + XGBoost/SHAP,
  p50 53 ms @ 18 rps, hash-chained audit ledger, bounded agent (approve/challenge/hold).
  https://github.com/WHITEJACK5/TRACER-Real-Time-Mule-Ring-Defense
- loan-default-risk — LightGBM isotonic PD on 1.35M LendingClub rows, ROC-AUC 0.69,
  PR-AUC 0.35 (2017+ hold-out), +$7.4M simulated profit policy, p50 29 ms serving.
  https://github.com/WHITEJACK5/loan-default-risk · demo https://whitejack5-loan-default-risk.hf.space
- RegRAG — citation-grounded QA over RBI regulation; verbatim quotes verified by
  code; refuses when the corpus does not support the answer. (building, D2/20)
  https://github.com/WHITEJACK5/RegRAG
- ArchVision AI — natural language / OpenAPI / SQL DDL → UML diagrams, 300 ms
  two-way sync, budgeted GPT-4o/Claude copilot. https://github.com/12POISON/ARCHvision-AI-uml
- WHITE COLLARS — job portal scraping real listings, one-click apply, staged
  Express→Turborepo architecture. Live https://white-collars.vercel.app
  https://github.com/WHITEJACK5/white-collars
- DRQR — self-hosted dynamic QR platform, 25+ types, scan analytics, LLM review
  summaries, JWT rotation + TOTP 2FA, 74.4% coverage.
  https://github.com/WHITEJACK5/DYNAMIC-QR

## Principles
1. Reproducible evaluation before optimization — a number you cannot re-derive is not a result.
2. Explainability is part of the model, not a wrapper.
3. Document the limits — failures admitted beat accuracy overstated.
4. Small, testable slices — a change that can be reviewed can be trusted.
